extracted.name: White chocolate martini
extracted.description: Enjoy the rich, smooth texture of white chocolate without the sickly sweetness in this martini – garnish the glass with white chocolate flakes before serving
ingredient_lines: 25ml crème de cacao (or use regular – the white version results in a paler cocktail)
instruction_lines: Tip the grated chocolate onto a plate. Brush the rim of a martini glass with a little maple syrup or honey, then dip into the chocolate to coat. Chill the glass until needed.

Pour the crème de cacao, cream, vanilla and vodka into a cocktail shaker and add a handful of ice. Shake until the outside of the shaker feels ice-cold. Strain the drink into the prepared glass to serve.
